title: Iron Deficiency Anemia Guidelines: Guidelines Summary
abstract: # Iron Deficiency Anemia Guidelines. The following organizations have published guidelines on iron deficiency anemia:. [Guideline] Snook J, Bhala N, Beales ILP, Cannings D, Kightley C, Logan RP, et al. AGA Clinical Practice Guidelines on the Gastrointestinal Evaluation of Iron Deficiency Anemia. [Guideline] Pennazio M, Rondonotti E, Despott EJ, et al. The Efficacy and Safety of Vitamin C for Iron Supplementation in Adult Patients With Iron Deficiency Anemia: A Randomized Clinical Trial. Ferric maltol is effective in correcting iron deficiency anemia in patients with inflammatory bowel disease: results from a phase-3 clinical trial program. Long-Term Effectiveness of Oral Ferric Maltol vs Intravenous Ferric Carboxymaltose for the Treatment of Iron-Deficiency Anemia in Patients With Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Randomized Controlled Noninferiority Trial. Marcel E Conrad, MD is a member of the following medical societies: Alpha Omega Alpha, American Association for the Advancement of Science, American Association of Blood Banks, American Chemical Society, American College of Physicians, American Physiological Society, American Society for Clinical Investigation, American Society of Hematology, Association of American Physicians, The Society of Federal Health Professionals (AMSUS), International Society of Hematology, Society for Experimental Biology and Medicine, SWOG.
